sloka: सो ऽब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा अयमस्मि नराधिप ।वश्यस्तव महाबाहो किङ्करः समुपस्थितः ।। ७.७५.७ ॥
transliteration: so 'bravītpraṇato bhūtvā ayamasmi narādhipa ।vaśyastava mahābāho kiṅkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ ।। 7.75.7 ॥

translations.english: Having bowed, the Pushpaka spoke, "O king of men, O mighty-armed one, I am your obedient servant, present here."
